text:
Priya (Sales): Kicking off Medivue POC thread. Goal: triage assistant that ingests clinical notes and returns short bulleted summaries + ranked source passages. Customer asks for sandbox with sanitized notes, eval prompts, and a cost estimate. Demo scheduled 14 days out.

Noah (Solutions Eng): Proposed approach: 1) synthetic dataset + customer redacted samples; 2) host in a short-lived S3 bucket with presigned links and strict IAM; 3) provide an eval harness (pytest style) for ROUGE/BERTScore + retrieval metrics.

Eloise (Security): Requirements from security review: show redaction pipeline and artifacts, DPA if any real data leaves their environment, retention <= 7 days for POC artifacts, audit log for downloads, KMS-encrypted at rest. We need the customer's security contact and whether they accept pseudonymization or only full redaction.

Rohan (Platform): Quick connectivity options: hosted sandbox (fastest), S3 with short-lived creds; private trial requires VPC peering and a network intro (2-3 business days after approvals). If they want sample data in their cloud, we can do presigned PUTs to our bucket and run scrub jobs.

Priya (Sales): Procurement question: are POC costs covered under free trial credit or do we need a paid dev seat? Also ask: will Medivue sign a temporary SOW for dedicated nodes if they need performance testing?

Noah (Solutions Eng): For rough sizing: assume 3 engineers hitting the API ~4k calls/day (mix of embed + gen). Using batching and caching, estimate ~30-50 GPU-hours for a 2-week run on our hosted fleet. If they request low-latency Dedicated GPUs, costs ~2-3x. I'll provide a clearer estimate after sim.

Eloise (Security): For the redaction approach we prefer deterministic pseudonymization + hashing for linkability between notes but no PII left in plaintext. Example helper (naive):
```
# simple pseudonymizer
import hashlib
import re

def hash_id(s):
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:10]

def pseudonymize(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b", lambda m: "SSN-"+hash_id(m.group(1)), text)
    text = re.sub(r"([A-Z][a-z]+\s[A-Z][a-z]+)", lambda m: "NAME-"+hash_id(m.group(0)), text)
    return text
```
Final scrub must be run by Medivue and validated by our SE.

Rohan (Platform): We'll provide an infra runbook and a k8s CronJob manifest to run the pseudonymizer at scale. Also can enable object lifecycle rules to auto-delete after the retention window.

Priya (Sales): Success criteria proposal: 1) average summary length <= 3 bullets and judges rate usefulness >= 4/5 on sample set; 2) Retrieval Recall@5 >= 0.75 on test queries; 3) no PHI leaks in audit sample. Owners: Noah -> eval harness + cost sims; Eloise -> security checklist & questionnaire; Rohan -> sandbox provisioning and lifecycle.

procurement-bot: Note: Request PR-892 for pricing estimate has been created and assigned to Noah.

Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the eval prompt set (50 clinical prompts covering discharge summaries, progress notes, and consults) and share a cost/runbook doc by EOD tomorrow. Also will include the playbook to switch to Private if latency fails thresholds.

Eloise (Security): I'll email Medivue's security contact for the questionnaire and request their legal to sign the DPA for redacted/pseudonymized data. If they insist on full production data, we'll need additional approvals.

Priya (Sales): Great. I'll add Medivue SRE + security contacts to the ticket and confirm the 2-week demo slot. Please keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
